collection.title: Smart City Cabrio 1998 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Smart City Cabrio 1998 to 2002 will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade
